existingCasinoObservations.observation: Slash /blackjack bet and prefix w!blackjack <bet> use legacy coins, pseudo-scores, and a replay view.
Slash /slot bet and prefix w!slot <bet> use legacy coins, three reels, and a legacy payout table.
Slash /cf tebakan bet and prefix w!cf use legacy coins and a two-times gross payout.
Slash /rps pilihan bet and prefix w!rps use legacy coins, refund draws, and pay two-times gross on wins.
Slash /tebak tebakan and prefix w!tebak have no stake and pay a fixed legacy reward.
Slash /gacha and prefix w!gacha charge a fixed legacy cost and return a cosmetic result.
Slash /box and prefix w!box charge a fixed legacy cost and return legacy coin rewards.
Current games use legacy wallet helpers, users.json statistics, general-purpose random, and non-persistent replay views; no Casino-specific durable session, ledger, or recovery schema is present.
ECY_BURN already exists as the authoritative ECY BURN system account and is included in supply reporting.

ownerDecisionRecords.decision: The 2% cap applies to total maximum reserved gross liability; effective maximum stake is exposure- and bankroll-limited and includes Blackjack Double or Split worst-case liability.
The approved rules keep six decks and H17, restrict Double to hard 11 and Split to Aces/8s, and pay a winning natural at 5:4 profit / 2.25x gross.
ownerDecisionRecords.condition: The complete deterministic rerun measured RTP 0.9748809836156533 and passed the approved tolerance, confidence, seed, and invariant gates.

ownerDecisionRecords.decision: Approve the exact equal-weight one-payline Slots table at 95% RTP with 1000-ECY wager increments.
Approve fair Coinflip with floor(stake*19400/10000) gross payout and 1000-ECY wager increments.
Approve uniform RPS, draw refund, floor(stake*19010/10000) win payout, and 1000-ECY wager increments.
Approve one-attempt 1-20 Number Guessing at 19x gross and 1000-ECY wager increments.
Approve cosmetic-only Gacha at fixed 1000 ECY with equal eight-label outcomes, no payout or inventory grant, and no liability reservation.
Approve the fixed 1000-ECY Loot Box table at 95% RTP and 15x maximum gross liability.

Approve one unresolved session per user, one active Blackjack session per user, 100 unresolved sessions per guild, ten-minute Blackjack abandonment, 90-second replay controls, and approved per-game cooldowns.
Approve mixed public/ephemeral result visibility with private errors, staff actions, and recovery details.
Preserve legacy users.json statistics byte-for-byte and snapshot them idempotently as read-only compatibility history; derive new statistics from committed settlements.
Preserve High Roller as legacy history and treat Lucky Charm as legacy-only with no Phase 5 odds effect.
Use the approved rolling-30-day committed non-Casino activity definition for active-member bankroll sizing.
Approve max(25,000,000 ECY, 100,000 ECY times active members) as the exact seed formula; production amount remains a cutover approval.
Use separately represented and audited CASINO_CONTROL, CASINO_FINANCIAL, and CASINO_RECOVERY authorization classes without Administrator or implicit owner financial bypass.
Approve manual excess distribution only while paused, retaining safe bankroll plus unresolved/review liabilities and allocating 60/20/remainder to general/reserve/burn.
Approve persisted-state recovery, timeout auto-stand, immutable identity replay, and audited recovery-class compensation for reviewed ambiguity.
Approve the deterministic simulation matrix and additional boundary/exposure cases with separate theoretical, simulated, rounded RTP, rejection, exposure, and drawdown reporting.
Migration identity 500 named phase5-casino is implemented for explicit non-production staging use only.
ECONOMY_PHASE5_ENABLED exists with default false; enabled missing prerequisites fail closed without legacy fallback.
